titleEn: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Richmond, BC? Real 2026 Project Budgets
titleZh: 列治文厨房装修费用2026：真實工程造價預算
contentEn:
In Richmond, BC, a kitchen renovation costs between $30,000 and $130,000 in 2026, depending on the scope of work. A cosmetic refresh starts around $30,000–$45,000. A standard mid-range renovation typically runs $45,000–$75,000. A full custom kitchen with structural changes can reach $75,000–$130,000 or more. Reno Stars has completed kitchen projects in Richmond since 2020, with prices verified against actual invoiced budgets.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Costs in Richmond?

Kitchen renovation costs in Richmond are shaped by five main cost categories. Cabinetry accounts for 30–40% of the total budget, countertops 15–20%, plumbing and electrical 10–15%, flooring 8–12%, and labour 15–20%. In Richmond specifically, older strata complexes often require electrical upgrades to meet current BC Electrical Code, which adds $1,500–$4,000 to the budget. Condos in high-rise buildings may incur additional fees of $500–$2,000 for below-ground utility access.

Cabinet Costs in Richmond: Material Options

Cabinet material choice is the single largest variable in a Richmond kitchen renovation. Thermofoil or laminate cabinets start at $150–$250 per linear foot for materials and installation. Solid wood or MDF with lacquer finish typically costs $350–$600 per linear foot. Custom solid wood cabinets with dovetail drawers cost $600–$1,200 per linear foot. For a typical 10x10 U-shaped kitchen (approximately 20 linear feet of cabinets), a mid-range option costs $18,000–$30,000 for cabinetry alone, installed.

Reno Stars sources cabinets from Metro Vancouver suppliers with lead times of 4–8 weeks for standard sizes and 8–14 weeks for custom orders. All cabinet installations in Richmond require a City of Richmond building permit if cabinet boxes are being relocated or if the kitchen layout is changing.

Richmond Condo Kitchen Renovation: Strata and Permit Rules

Many Richmond kitchens are in strata-titled condos. Strata approval is required before any plumbing work or electrical changes. The process typically takes 2–6 weeks depending on the strata council schedule. Reno Stars has experience navigating strata approvals in Richmond's major complexes and can submit the required Form B and renovation deposit on the owner's behalf.

For condo kitchens in Richmond, BC Building Code requires that any work involving gas lines must be performed by a licensed gas technician, and any electrical panel upgrades must comply with BC Electrical Code 2024. The City of Richmond charges $150 per inspection visit, with most kitchen renovations requiring 2–3 inspections.

Timeline: Kitchen Renovation in Richmond, BC

A standard kitchen renovation in Richmond takes 6–12 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. Cosmetic refresh projects typically complete in 4–6 weeks. Mid-range renovations requiring cabinet orders and countertop templating run 8–10 weeks. Projects involving structural changes or condo strata approval can extend to 12–16 weeks.

The permitting timeline with the City of Richmond is typically 5–10 business days for a kitchen renovation permit. Reno Stars handles the full permit application including electrical, plumbing, and gas rough-in coordination. All work is performed by licensed trades holding active BC trade certifications.

FAQs: Kitchen Renovation Costs in Richmond, BC

How much does a small kitchen renovation cost in Richmond, BC?

A small kitchen renovation in Richmond—replacing cabinets, countertops, and flooring without changing the layout—typically costs $25,000–$40,000. This assumes no electrical or plumbing reconfiguration and uses mid-range materials. A cosmetic-only refresh can be as low as $15,000–$25,000.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Richmond?

Yes, a City of Richmond building permit is required for any kitchen renovation involving moving plumbing fixtures, altering electrical circuits, or changing the cabinet layout. Cosmetic work may not require a permit, but any work changing the footprint or utility locations requires one. Permit fees range from $150 to $450 depending on the project value.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Richmond?

A standard mid-range kitchen renovation in Richmond takes 8–12 weeks from permit approval to final walkthrough. The longest delays typically come from cabinet lead times (4–8 weeks for standard sizes, 8–14 weeks for custom). Countertop templating and installation adds another 2–3 weeks after cabinet installation.

What is the average cost of a kitchen renovation in Richmond per square foot?

In Richmond, BC, a complete kitchen renovation costs $150–$350 per square foot of kitchen area, depending on the material tier. This includes cabinetry, countertops, flooring, labour, and permit fees but excludes appliances if they are not part of the scope.

在BC省列治文，2026年廚房裝修費用介於30,000至130,000加元之間，具體取決於工程範圍。輕裝修starting around $30,000–$45,000。標準中檔裝修typically runs $45,000–$75,000。全訂製廚房連結構改動can reach $75,000–$130,000 or more。聚星裝修自2020年以來已在列治文完成多個廚房項目，價格均以實際發票預算核實。

什麼因素影響列治文廚房裝修費用？

列治文廚房裝修費用主要受五個類別影響。櫥櫃佔總預算30%至40%，檯面15%至20%，水電工程10%至15%，地板8%至12%，人工15%至20%。在列治文，較舊的分契式大樓通常需要升級電力系統以符合現行BC省電氣規範，額外費用約為1,500至4,000加元。高層柏文可能涉及額外費用500至2,000加元，用於地下公用設施通道。

列治文廚房裝修費用明細表

裝修級別工程範圍估算費用
輕裝修櫃門板更換、牆面油漆、硬件更新、照明設備升級$30,000 – $45,000
標準中檔新式櫻桃木/模壓板櫥櫃、石英石檯面、更新水管裝置、新地板$45,000 – $75,000
高端訂製全訂製實木櫥櫃、天然石材檯面、帶煮食爐的中島、開放式格局$75,000 – $105,000
豪華結構式拆除結構牆、訂製木工製品、一體化電器、專業級抽油煙機$105,000 – $130,000+

列治文櫥櫃費用：材料選擇

櫥櫃材料選擇是列治文廚房裝修中最大的變數。熱壓成型板或層壓板櫥櫃starts at $150–$250 per linear foot for materials and installation。實木或中密度纖維板加漆面typically costs $350–$600 per linear foot。訂製實木櫥櫃with dovetail drawers cost $600–$1,200 per linear foot。對於典型的10x10 U形廚房（約20直線英尺櫥櫃），中檔選項costs $18,000–$30,000 for cabinetry alone, installed。

聚星裝修從Metro Vancouver供應商採購櫥櫃，標準尺寸交貨期為4至8週，訂製尺寸為8至14週。所有列治文櫥櫃安裝工程均需申請列治文市建築許可證，若需搬遷櫥櫃箱體或更改廚房佈局。

列治文柏文廚房裝修：分契條例與許可規定

許多列治文廚房位於分契式柏文。任何人水電工程或電路更改均需分契業主立案法團批准。流程通常需時2至6週，視乎管理委員會日程。聚星裝修熟悉列治文主要分契大樓的分契審批流程，可代表業主提交所需的Form B及裝修押金。

BC省建築規範要求，涉及煤氣管道工程必須由持牌煤氣技師處理，電箱升級亦須符合2024年BC省電氣規範。列治文市每次巡查收費150加元，大多廚房裝修需接受2至3次巡查。

列治文廚房裝修時間表

列治文標準廚房裝修從許可獲批到最終驗收需時6至12週。輕裝修工程通常4至6週完成。需要訂購櫥櫃及模板石材的中檔裝修需8至10週。涉及結構改動或分契審批的項目可延長至12至16週。

列治文市廚房裝修許可審批時間通常為5至10個工作日。聚星裝修代為處理全部許可申請，包括電工、水管及煤氣粗糙接口的協調。所有工程均由持有有效BC省職業證書的持牌技工執行。

  • 溫暖簡約廚房裝修 — 暖色實木貼面櫥櫃、木紋瓷磚地板、櫃底照明、單層式中島。2025年完工。預算：$44,000至$58,000。 查看工程

常見問題：列治文廚房裝修費用

列治文小廚房裝修費用是多少？

列治文小廚房裝修——在不改動佈局的情況下更換櫥櫃、檯面和地板——通常費用為25,000至40,000加元。這假設不涉及電路或水管重新配置，並使用中檔材料。純美容式翻新可低至15,000至25,000加元。

列治文廚房裝修需要許可證嗎？

是的，任何涉及移動水管裝置、改變電路或更改櫥櫃佈局的廚房裝修均需申請列治文市建築許可證。美容裝修可能不需要許可證，但任何改變佔地面積或公用設施位置的工程均需許可證。許可證費用根據項目價值從150至450加元不等。

列治文廚房裝修需要多長時間？

列治文標準中檔廚房裝修從許可批准到最終驗收需8至12週。最長的延誤通常來自櫥櫃交貨期（標準尺寸4至8週，訂製尺寸8至14週）。石材模板製作及安裝在櫥櫃安裝後另需2至3週。

列治文廚房裝修每平方英尺平均費用是多少？

在BC省列治文，全面廚房裝修費用為每平方英尺廚房面積150至350加元，視材料級別而定。這包括櫥櫃、檯面，地磚、人工及許可證費用，但不包括電器（若不在工程範圍內）。
